allocator.warning: The startup probe commits and retains large arenas. Freeing a resource returns a block to the CRT pool, not to DOS; aggregate free-block extent does not prove that one contiguous allocation can succeed, and each free hole itself retains a two-byte header.

confidence.derived: Arithmetic combination of exact values with assumptions stated beside the value.
confidence.exact: Authenticated binary disassembly, exact DAT bytes, or exact allocator arithmetic.
confidence.measured: Observed in the isolated stock DOSBox 0.74-3 control profile.
confidence.path_dependent: The startup DOS commitment is measured; which free holes remain inside each CRT arena after a particular play history still depends on allocation order.
